items.html: And behold, the Daat of this Partzuf has within it five Hassadim and five Gevurot, as mentioned. And the five Hassadim that are in this Daat of this Partzuf, while they are still above, before entering within ZA to become inner Mochin within him — before their entry, these five Hassadim spread there through the five Sefirot, the ChGT NH of that fine Partzuf. And understand this well.
